item.title: GO in vaccines / 5G activation claims
item.description:
Evidence: Fringe

Recycled claims that COVID vaccines contain graphene oxide and/or that GO can be “activated” by 5G. Mid-September 2026 posts repeated 2021-era microscopy and petition-hearing material.

Why Fringe

  • Licensed vaccine ingredient lists (FDA, EMA, MHRA and manufacturers) do not include graphene oxide.
  • GO has been used in lab imaging (e.g. cryo-EM) of spike protein — that is not a formulation ingredient.
  • Viral “self-assembly” clips have been traced by fact-checkers to a pre-COVID high-voltage physics demonstration.

See [[weekly/2026-W38]] and [[recurrence/log]].

item.title: Poison or pencil lead
item.description:
Parent: [[topics/fringe]]. Health numbers: [[topics/health/effects]]. Forms: [[reference/forms]].

The two slogans

“Graphene is poison.” Treats GO, dry nanoplatelet powder, and a peeled monolayer as one object. Ignores the short human GO inhalation study (Andrews 2024 / NCT03659864) and the absence of a worker case series in the reviews NIOSH used. Also ignores that high-dose rodent lung work is real — just not a license to use the word “poison” for every sheet.

item.title: Spray and weather
item.description:
Parent: [[topics/fringe]]. Label on this column is Fringe unless a primary says otherwise.

What circulates

  • Aircraft contrails recast as “chemtrails” that contain graphene or GO.
  • Weather-control or solar-geoengineering programmes said to spray graphene as the payload.
  • The same payload then tied to 5G, vaccines, or livestock deaths in one thread.

What the public record actually holds

  • Graphene-family powders are made in plants and labs. That is [[topics/manufacturing/directory]].
  • Occupational air samples exist at some of those plants. That is [[topics/health/effects]] (NIOSH field notes).
  • There is no regulator text on this shelf that treats graphene as an authorized aerial-spray climate tool.
  • A toxicity paper in rodents is not a flight log. [[reference/safety]]

Why it stays on Fringe

The jump is always the same: a real material + a real high-dose paper + a photograph of a sky → a programme. The middle step is missing. Missing citation = [[logs/unsourced]]. A cover-up story = this column.
